## Description

Models order execution scheduling by coupling self-exciting Hawkes point processes for order arrivals with non-linear transitory and permanent market impact functions.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block orders, volatile order book depth environments, high-frequency execution desks.

## Vehicles

Agency execution desks, algorithmic trading brokerages, institutional quantitative funds.

## Required data

Tick-level limit order book event logs, trade execution timestamps, historical market impact coefficients.

## Caveats

Requires calibration of self-exciting kernels; sensitive to sudden structural shifts in order flow toxicity.
